fr.recommendations:
• Install a reflective address marker at the driveway entrance visible from both directions of travel on the street.
• Trim vegetation along the driveway edges to maintain a clear path wide enough for emergency vehicles.
• Cut back dense vegetation near the structure to create a clear gap between plants and the building walls.
• Remove or thin any dense plantings that block the view of the front door and walkway from the street.
• Keep the driveway and parking area clear of parked vehicles to allow emergency vehicles to reach the front of the structure.
• Trim shrubs and low tree branches along the walkway so responders can move on foot from the driveway to the front door without obstruction.
• Mark the single driveway entrance with visible posts or reflectors so responders can locate it quickly at night or in low-visibility conditions.
• Thin dense vegetation on both sides of the driveway to reduce the risk of it blocking access if branches fall across the drive.

wildfire.recommendations:
• Thin the tree cluster nearest to the structure to create open space between individual trees and the building.
• Trim branches on large trees that extend directly over or toward the structure.
• Remove shrubs and low-growing plants that are growing against or immediately next to the structure walls.
• Separate the ring of vegetation surrounding the structure by cutting back plants on all sides to open space between them and the building.
• Thin scattered trees across the property so individual tree canopies no longer touch each other.
• Remove dead branches and dry plant material from within the mixed vegetation areas closest to the structure.
• Cut back shrubs and low plants growing beneath large trees near the structure to remove the connection between ground-level plants and tree canopies.
• Clear overhanging branches from above the driveway to keep the single access route open for vehicles.
• Keep the full width of the driveway clear of encroaching vegetation along both sides.
• Mark the driveway entrance clearly so it is easy to locate from the road, especially in smoky conditions.
• Maintain a visible, unobstructed path completely around the structure by cutting back plants that limit movement close to the building.
• Remove any wood piles, stored materials, or loose debris stored against or directly next to the structure.
